name: Bovine Dilemma
justification: Geometry story boils down to counting distinct pairwise differences; tiny n, single-integer answer.
solution_sketch: Apex is fixed at (0,1) with height 1, so triangle area = base/2. Distinct areas = distinct base lengths = distinct x_j - x_i over all pairs; n <= 50 allows O(n^2) set insertion.
